description: Two-LOB NIGO cluster with an estimate in band 3.

cluster.name: Manual NIGO checks on subscription forms

summary.description: Operations teams check subscription forms by hand and find gaps too late.
summary.problem: Physical SIP and SIF subscription forms are checked by hand against a printed list. Gaps are found after the NAV cut-off and investors lose a day.

solution.text: Validate mandatory fields when the form is scanned.

open_questions: What share of NIGO cases could a scanner catch?

ideas.one_line: Branch staff re-check every SIP form by hand
ideas.details: About one in five forms still comes back NIGO a day later.

ideas.one_line: SIF forms bounce for missing nominee details
ideas.details: Each bounce costs a call to the distributor.

anchors.1: Under ₹5 lakh a year of net benefit
Investors, distributors or clients would barely notice
anchors.3: A clear improvement for one group of customers
anchors.5: A change many customers would talk about
Removes a known regulatory or operational risk

anchors.1: One team or a handful of people
anchors.3: One LOB or one client segment
anchors.5: Several LOBs or most of KFintech's clients

anchors.1: More than a year to any benefit
anchors.5: Benefit within a month or two

anchors.1: A large programme across many teams
anchors.3: A few people for a quarter
anchors.5: A small change one team can make

scores.rationale: About ₹31 lakh a year of net benefit sits in band 3; the figures are estimates, so no move.
Investors lose a day when gaps are found after the cut-off; catching them at the counter fixes that.
Neutral on regulatory risk; fewer NIGO cases slightly lower operational risk.
Two LOBs and every branch that takes physical forms.
About ten weeks to first benefit.
About twelve person-weeks: a few people for a quarter.
